title: Databases larger than their server average
description: Return exactly three columns: server_name, name, size_mb for databases whose size is strictly greater than the average database size on the same server. Sort by server_name ASC, then size_mb DESC, then name ASC when size_mb ties.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.server_name, d.name, d.size_mb
FROM databases AS d
hints: The subquery average must be limited to the current server_name.
Compare d.size_mb with a correlated AVG(size_mb).
solution_explanation: The correlated subquery calculates an average independently for each server.
